long_description:

Our AI agents handle both revenue and ops; answering phones 24/7, booking jobs in real time, following up on leads, and alerting techs when emergencies hit.

We’ve grown from 0 to 800+ contractors in under 2 years, raised Series A round led by Khosla Ventures to take on one of the biggest labor automation opportunities in the country.

Together, Adi and AJ co-founded Telematica, where they built energy-management systems for large European utilities and charging-point operators. They have raised $1.5M for Telematica and $25M for Broccoli.

long_description:
HVAC, plumbing, roofing, and electrical companies spend $3K–$25K every month making the phone ring - then lose 10–20% of those leads to slow response times, missed calls, and zero follow-up. The revenue was already there. It just walked out the back door.

Cactus closes that gap on both sides.

Inbound: Every call answered in under 60 seconds, 24/7 qualified and booked directly into Housecall Pro, Jobber, FieldEdge, or ServiceTitan. No voicemails. No missed jobs.

Outbound: Warm leads, dormant customers, and unworked estimates get proactively contacted - driving repeat jobs, cross-sells, upsells, and referrals without adding headcount.

The result: 20–30% more jobs from the ad budget you're already spending.

What that looks like in practice:

→ Roofing company, NC | $299K collected in 10 weeks. $1.41M pipeline created. 199× ROI. $48K of that revenue came in after hours — while the office was closed.

→ Plumbing & HVAC company, UT | $180K confirmed revenue in 4 months. 90× ROI. 58% of captured leads came after hours — jobs that would have gone to voicemail now go straight into the CRM.

→ General contracting company | Grew from 11 jobs/month to 72 in a single month — 555% growth. $2.09M invoiced. $1.82M collected. Zero new hires.

→ Roofing & siding company | $228K pipeline in 75 days. 92% of calls converted to hot leads. $804K in net sales during the Cactus period. 49 spam calls filtered automatically — hours of staff time saved.

→ Commercial signage company | $398K pipeline generated in 10 weeks. 111× ROI on $3,597 invested. Grew from 0% to 30% share of total company pipeline in a single month.

If we don't add revenue, we don't stay. That's the only way this works.

The $150B home services industry is still running on voicemail and spreadsheets. We're building the system that changes that - one answered call at a time.
name: Cactus
one_liner: All-In-One AI Growth Partner. Built for Trades.

long_description:

CentralComs fixes this with AI agents that answer every call, route each job to the right technician, and keep the calendar full. They handle intake, dispatch, and customer updates end to end working inside ServiceTitan, Housecall Pro, and Jobber so no lead slips through and no truck runs empty.

Capture every call. Book every tech. Never miss a job.

long_description:
Bernard builds AI employees for home and commercial appliance servicers. They work across phone, text, email, warranty feeds, and existing systems to manage customer communication, scheduling, and dispatch, carrying each job through diagnosis, parts preparation, technician handoff, and follow-up. At the center is Pre-ID, which combines the exact appliance and its symptoms with repair history, similar completed visits, manufacturer guidance, and parts data to produce a diagnosis, ranked parts, and follow-up questions. Technicians arrive prepared with the right parts, helping servicers complete more repairs on the first visit.

We’re building the world’s most efficient appliance servicers, creating happier customers and a more connected appliance ecosystem.

Learn more at https://bernardhq.com/
name: Bernard
one_liner: AI employees that run home appliance repair companies
